frequency_question: How often do complex bilateral water treaty renewals achieve technical finalization and signature within a 125-day administrative window once initiated?
membership_rule: Includes formal inter-governmental water sharing treaty renewals or successor agreements involving joint hydrological data collection, technical committee drafts, and ministerial approvals; excludes unilateral declarations or informal non-binding understandings.

cases.name: Indus Waters Treaty renegotiations and extensions (historical practice)
Mahakali Treaty supplementary and implementation talks
Teesta River interim water sharing draft negotiations (stalled)
Ganga Water Treaty initial 1996 finalization window

provenance_note: claims 14 cases from only 4 named (3.5x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 4 named instances directly matched; estimated 14 comparable major transboundary river treaty renewal processes globally in the reference window.
known_gaps: Excludes minor tributary level adjustments handled entirely by local joint commissions without central executive treaties.
skeleton: Total bilateral water negotiations reaching completion within 4 months of intensive drafting versus those requiring multi-year cycles
multiplier: 4 rapid-finalization technical agreements divided by 14 total initiated or pending river water treaty renewal cycles globally over the past 50 years
validity_reason: Bureaucratic drafting speeds and diplomatic protocol norms for treaty ratification remain stable over multi-year horizons barring structural shifts in international law.
